cascadeSummary: Approved month-ten disbursement of $400,000, maintaining rigorous compliance standards. Adjusted outreach to focus on commercial-residential hybrid cases as West Oakland's economic landscape shifts.

statements.decision: Approved month-ten disbursement of $400,000 for 10 additional households.
statements.quote: Ninety-one households stabilized means ninety-one West Oakland families who won’t face displacement this month—and every case file meets compliance standards that will survive audit.
statements.fullStatement: The Office of Economic and Workforce Development has approved the month-ten disbursement of $400,000 under Deputy Mayor Okoro’s authority, stabilizing 10 additional households in West Oakland. This brings the total disbursement to $5 million, with rigorous compliance standards ensuring every case file meets audit scrutiny. We’ve adjusted our outreach to focus on commercial-residential hybrid cases as West Oakland’s economic landscape shifts. Ninety-one households stabilized means ninety-one West Oakland families who won’t face displacement this month.
